entries.title: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure'
entries.snippet: Abbas Araghchi says the US attacks each time there is a diplomatic solution on the table.

entries.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine to observe three-day ceasefire
entries.snippet: It comes as the two countries accused each other of violating separate ceasefires to cover the celebrations of the Soviet Union's victory over Nazi Germany.

entries.title: Anger and resignation in Tenerife as hantavirus ship approaches
entries.snippet: Some on the Spanish island worry that the imminent arrival of the MV Hondius could pose a health risk.

entries.title: Greece examines mystery naval drone found in Ionian Sea
entries.snippet: Greek media say the drone, which reportedly had explosives, could be either Ukrainian or linked to the Russia-Ukraine war.

entries.title: Hovering objects and flashing lights: what we learned from UFO documents released by the Pentagon
entries.snippet: The US has published transcripts, video clips and audio recordings about unidentified flying objects, also called unidentified anomalous phenomena.

entries.title: Hungary's new PM to be sworn in during 'regime change' party
entries.snippet: Nearly a month ago Péter Magyar steered his Tisza party to a landslide victory, sweeping away 16 years of rule by Viktor Orbán.

entries.title: International cyber attack disrupts swathe of universities and schools
entries.snippet: A hacking group breached the academic software Canvas, used by thousands of schools and universities across the globe.

entries.title: Three dead after volcano erupts on Indonesian island
entries.snippet: Officials had previously issued warnings on climbing the active volcano due to safety concerns.

entries.title: White House calls Mark Hamill 'sick' after actor's Trump grave post
entries.snippet: The Star Wars actor apologised and deleted the post, which contained an AI image of the president in a shallow grave.

entries.title: Worldwide race to trace passengers from hantavirus-hit cruise ship
entries.snippet: About 12 countries have so far been linked to the hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius, as the UN health agency confirms at least five cases.

entries.title: Oil prices rise after US and Iran exchange fire in Hormuz strait
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump says the ceasefire between Washington and Tehran is still in place.

entries.title: South Africa president faces call to resign after court ruling
entries.snippet: The Constitutional Court says MPs were was wrong to block impeachment proceedings against Cyril Ramaphosa.

entries.title: US jet fuel could be used in Europe to ease possible shortages
entries.snippet: An international air body suggests wider acceptance of US-grade jet fuel could help to head off any supply problems.

entries.title: Anti-war protests rock Japan as PM pushes for stronger defence
entries.snippet: Japan's largest anti-war protests in decades highlight a population divided over changes to its pacifist constitution.

entries.title: Rebel Wilson accused of 'complete revision of history' as defamation case closes
entries.snippet: The Bridesmaids star claims an actress retracted a complaint about sexual harassment by a producer.

entries.title: Two Islamic-State linked Australian women charged with crimes against humanity
entries.snippet: A third woman who also returned to Australia from Syria was charged with joining a terrorist organisation.

entries.title: Ethiopian woman's joy at rare quintuplets after 12 years trying for a baby
entries.snippet: The woman, 35, says she was praying for a baby and was "overjoyed" to be "blessed with five at once".

entries.title: Third British national has suspected hantavirus infection, UK government says
entries.snippet: Five cases of hantavirus have been confirmed in total, including one of the three passengers on the MV Hondius who died.

entries.title: World Cup fans in China and India face broadcast uncertainty
entries.snippet: Broadcasters in the two countries have yet to reach deals with Fifa, just weeks before the tournament is due to start.

entries.title: Trump gives EU ultimatum deadline to approve trade deal with US
entries.snippet: Trump's deadline to the European Union came as a trade court ruled his global tariff policy violated US law.

entries.title: UFO files spanning decades are released by Defense Department
entries.snippet: Cold War reports of mysterious rotating saucers; recent sightings of metallic elliptical objects floating in mid-air. Those and other reports of unidentified anomalous phenomena or UAPs — the military's term for UFOs — are described in documents released Friday.

entries.title: Canvas is back online, but questions — and final exam disruptions — linger
entries.snippet: Some schools are warning users not to log back into Canvas yet, after a ransomware group claimed credit for a data breach. Half of North America's higher education institutions use the platform.

entries.title: Colombia's rogue hippos could find refuge in India
entries.snippet: In Colombia, a plan to cull Pablo Escobar's invasive hippos is challenged by an Indian billionaire's offer to relocate dozens of the animals to India's wildlife reserve instead.

entries.title: Contact tracing could be key in halting the spread of hantavirus. Here's how it works
entries.snippet: More than two dozen passengers left the cruise ship before the outbreak was identified. The race is on to connect with them to monitor their health — and the health of those they've interacted with.

entries.title: As federal government pulls back, Colorado charts independent course with vaccines
entries.snippet: As state leaders change laws to make vaccines more accessible, a coalition of doctors, public health advocates and everyday Coloradans is trying to start a public conversation about their importance.

entries.title: Court rejects Virginia redistricting in a blow to Democrats' counter to Trump, GOP
entries.snippet: Virginia voters approved redistricting that could help Democrats pick up four House seats. Democrats said it was to counter the gains that Trump and the GOP have picked up in Republican-led states.

entries.title: Rooted in nature, 'Silent Friend' will change the way you see the trees
entries.snippet: A new art-house drama tells three stories that span the century — and connect to one tree. Silent Friend will open your eyes to the beauty of the natural world.

entries.title: U.S. intercepts Iranian attacks on 3 ships. And, what to know about hantavirus
entries.snippet: The U.S. says it intercepted Iranian attacks yesterday targeting three Navy ships. And, what to know about the hantavirus outbreak that started on a cruise ship.

entries.title: The U.S. fires on Iranian tankers trying to evade its blockade amid a Hormuz standoff
entries.snippet: U.S. forces fired on two Iranian oil tankers after exchanging fire with Iranian forces in the Strait of Hormuz. And the United Arab Emirates reported another Iranian missile and drone attack.

entries.title: Military drills on the edge: U.S. and allies test capabilities near Asia's flash points
entries.snippet: From drone boats to long-range missiles, the U.S. and its allies tested new military tactics in the Philippines, sharpening deterrence as tensions with China intensify.

entries.title: U.S. strikes on Iranian tankers raise more questions over negotiations to end war
entries.snippet: As the world waits to hear if there will be diplomatic progress between the U.S. and Iran, on Friday U.S. fighter jets fired on Iranian vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, as part of the ongoing U.S. blockade. Meanwhile, Secretary of State Rubio continued his visit to Rome, where he

entries.title: What a stronger than expected jobs report tells us about the state of the economy
entries.snippet: The Labor Department reported Friday that unemployment held steady in April and that the U.S. added 115,000 jobs, surpassing expectations. For more on the numbers and what they tell us about the state of the economy, Amna Nawaz speaks with Mohamed El-Erian, a professor at the Wha

entries.title: News Wrap: Pentagon releases 'never-before-seen' UFO files on its website
entries.snippet: In our news wrap Friday, the Pentagon began releasing new files on UFOs, health authorities in the Canary Islands are preparing for the arrival of the cruise ship with a hantavirus outbreak, a jury convicted four men of conspiracy in the assassination of Haiti's president in 2021

entries.title: Virginia's Supreme Court tosses voter-approved redistricting plan in blow to Democrats
entries.snippet: Virginia's Supreme Court has struck down a voter-approved plan to redraw the state's congressional maps to benefit Democrats. It was a major setback for Democrats, as both parties wage a war of mid-decade redistricting. David Wasserman of the Cook Political Report with Amy Walter

entries.title: Why FDA Commissioner Makary is on the ropes after months of turmoil
entries.snippet: Multiple outlets are reporting that Trump is set to fire Food and Drug Administration Commissioner Marty Makary. The news comes after a tumultuous tenure since his installment as FDA head last year. Stephanie Sy speaks with Liz Whyte, health policy reporter at the Wall Street Jou

entries.title: New U.S. counterterror strategy focuses on drug cartels but omits right-wing extremism
entries.snippet: American counterterrorism officials are meeting Friday with officials from other allied nations to coordinate efforts against what the U.S. calls "deadly threats from terror groups and non-state actors." But the recently released U.S. strategy to fight terrorism contains some unu

entries.title: Brooks and Marcus on Virginia's major shakeup in the national redistricting battle
entries.snippet: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Ruth Marcus of The New Yorker join Amna Nawaz to discuss the week in politics, including the Virginia Supreme Court's decision to strike down a voter-approved congressional map and developments in the war with Iran.

entries.title: Cyberattack on Canvas platform highlights vulnerabilities and risks for schools
entries.snippet: The online education platform Canvas is mostly back online Friday after a cyberattack left students and teachers at thousands of schools and universities scrambling. The attack has raised many questions about the vulnerability of schools, the dependence on such platforms and othe

entries.title: What Russia's low‑key Victory Day celebrations reveal about Putin and the war in Ukraine
entries.snippet: Rumblings of unhappiness with some of the Kremlin's wartime policies have put the spotlight on Vladimir Putin, who is due to make a speech on Saturday to mark Victory Day, commemorating victory over Nazi Germany 81 years ago.

entries.title: Prosecutors aim to strip U.S. citizenship from diplomat-turned-spy
entries.snippet: The Trump administration moved this week to denaturalize 11 other people accused of crimes, including child sexual abuse and providing material support to terrorists.

entries.title: U.S. fires on and disables 2 more Iranian tankers as tensions rise in the Strait of Hormuz
entries.snippet: The attacks cast more doubt on a tenuous month-old ceasefire that the United States has insisted is still in effect.

entries.title: Trump is lifting restrictions on hunting in national parks and other areas
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump's administration is quietly pushing national park, refuge and wilderness area managers to dramatically scale back hunting restrictions, raising questions about visitor safety and the impact on wildlife.

entries.title: White House Correspondents' Dinner suspect seeks recusal of top DOJ officials
entries.snippet: A man charged with attacking the White House Correspondents' Association dinner is seeking to disqualify top Justice Department officials from direct involvement in prosecuting him because they could be considered victims or witnesses in the case, creating a potential conflict of

entries.title: What we don't know about the hantavirus outbreak on the cruise ship
entries.snippet: Authorities and the cruise operator have been providing updates, but some key information is still lacking.

entries.title: A state-by-state guide to the redistricting fight
entries.snippet: Republicans have opened up an advantage in a national redistricting battle among states after a pair of court rulings that weakened federal Voting Rights Act protections for minorities and invalidated a key Democratic redistricting effort.

entries.title: Alabama lawmakers pass plan for new U.S. House primary if courts allow different districts
entries.snippet: Demonstrators outside the Alabama Statehouse on Friday shouted "fight for democracy" and "down with white supremacy."

entries.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine have agreed to his request for a 3-day ceasefire, prisoner swap
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump announced on social media that the ceasefire would run Saturday through Monday. Saturday is Victory Day in Russia, a holiday that commemorates its victory over Nazi Germany 81 years ago in World War II.

entries.title: Trump drives across Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool to inspect blue coating he's adding
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump on Thursday went on an unannounced trip to the Lincoln Memorial to see the Reflecting Pool after he had it coated in a color he calls "American flag blue."

entries.title: Judge finds Trump's DOGE-led cancellation of humanities grants unconstitutional
entries.snippet: The Trump administration's cancellation of more than $100 million in humanities grants to scholars, writers, research groups and other organizations was unconstitutional, and the Department of Government Efficiency had no authority to end the funding, a federal judge ruled on Thu

entries.title: Happy birthday, David Attenborough. The man behind the excited but hushed voice of nature programs turns 100
entries.snippet: The BBC is hosting a party at the Royal Albert Hall, and cinemas are playing his nature films - but despite the accolades, Attenborough prefers the animals to be the stars.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Pakistan: Drop in Gulf remittances puts families on edge
entries.snippet: For millions of households, money sent by Pakistani workers in the Gulf offers a lifeline, helping their families cover basic needs such as food and education.

entries.title: Trump announces 3-day ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia
entries.snippet: The US president said both sides had agreed to halt fighting from May 9 to 11 and to exchange 1,000 prisoners each. Both Ukraine and Russia confirmed the ceasefire and prisoner exchange. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: US: Pentagon releases trove of classified UFO files
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump hailed his government's move to release over a 100 UFO-related documents as "complete and maximum transparency."

entries.title: How real is a coup threat against Russia's president?
entries.snippet: Increased security around Vladimir Putin and a scaling back of public appearances have given rise to suspicions of a coup or assassination attempt. Yet some observers remain skeptical.

entries.title: Hantavirus: Spain readies to receive cruise ship
entries.snippet: Spanish authorities are readying to receive the cruise ship at the center of the hantavirus outbreak. The WHO has confirmed six hantavirus cases linked to the ship so far.

entries.title: Christians decry persecution in India's heartland
entries.snippet: With Christians in India increasingly targeted by Hindu vigilantes, victims say police often side with their attackers.

entries.title: New film portrays Thomas and Erika Mann — with an oddly twisted premise
entries.snippet: Premiering at Cannes and starring Sandra Hüller, Pawel Pawlikowski's "Fatherland" is set during the Cold War — a complex period for the prominent anti-Nazi intellectuals.

entries.title: UAE charts its own course across the Middle East and Africa
entries.snippet: Close relations with Israel and the United States have placed the United Arab Emirates in Iran's crosshairs as Abu Dhabi pursues a more independent foreign policy than many Gulf countries, including Saudi Arabia.

entries.title: Hungary: New govt intent on initiating swift systemic change
entries.snippet: Peter Magyar and his government are determined to push ahead with change at full throttle. But even before the cabinet is sworn in, there has been a "resignation." And questions remain about Magyar's Ukraine policy.

entries.title: Fertilizer shortages: What are Africa's options during the Hormuz crisis?
entries.snippet: The ongoing blockade of the Strait of Hormuz is affecting African nations particularly badly. But there are potential solutions for mitigating the drastic effects on the continent in the short, medium and long term.

entries.title: Pioneer in the fight against AIDS: Botswana's ex-President Festus Mogae died
entries.snippet: The former President of the Republic of Botswana, Festus Mogae, has died. The democrat was considered the architect of the Southern African country's economic rise and a pioneer in the fight against AIDS.

entries.title: Why Russia has scaled back May 9 Victory Parade
entries.snippet: This year's May 9 military parades in Moscow will be much more modest and have been canceled altogether in other parts of Russia. The Kremlin has blamed Ukraine.

entries.title: Germany: AfD benefits from discontent with Merz's government
entries.snippet: Never before has a German government been this unpopular after only one year in office as that of Chancellor Friedrich Merz. The far-right AfD is capitalizing on this.

entries.title: Germany news: Exports jump higher than expected
entries.snippet: Exports from Germany had risen at a time when many feared they would be in retreat because of punishing US tariffs. Meanwhile, one of Germany's biggest banks is set to cut jobs to fend off a takeover.

entries.title: Germany: Hostages freed at bank after suspect flees scene
entries.snippet: A siege is over after at least one armed suspect intercepted a cash transport service in a western German town and took bank employees hostage. The suspected perpetrator remains at large.

entries.title: South Africa Constitutional Court orders Parliament to revisit Ramaphosa impeachment proceedings
entries.snippet: Cyril Ramaphosa's presidency is on the line, as lawmakers will now have to reconsider whether there are grounds to impeach him over the scandal dubbed "Farmgate."

entries.title: China: Calls for death penalty after teen gets life sentence
entries.snippet: A 14-year-old in China's Yunnan province has been convicted of intentional homicide and rape, and sentenced to life in prison. The victim's family argue he deserves the death penalty.

entries.title: Indonesia volcano eruption kills 3 hikers, several missing
entries.snippet: Rescuers are rushing to find missing hikers, three of whom have been declared dead after a volcanic eruption in eastern Indonesia.

entries.title: ASEAN leaders meet to discuss plans to ease Iran war impacts
entries.snippet: Southeast Asian leaders are meeting in the Philippines, with the economic fallout from the Iran war the main focus. Disputes in the South China Sea and border clashes between Thailand and Cambodia are also on the agenda.
